methodology: Complete Senate LDA quarterly reports (LD-2) for the window, deduped so the latest amendment supersedes the original per registrant+client+period. Dollar amounts gated for plausibility (income <= $5M, expenses <= $50M per filing). Committee attribution resolves each filing’s disclosed government_entities to committees; a filing naming multiple committees counts toward each, so committee totals are spending on filings that disclose the committee, not a partition.
